instruction.sentence_length: short single-clause sentences of about 5-8 words; two sentences in a row once the learner is comfortable
instruction.hint_timing: wait about five seconds of silence, then give one short hint; correct the article or the /n/ sound only after the learner finishes speaking

level.reason: 짧은 패턴 문장은 스스로 만들 수 있지만 관사와 an 발음이 아직 불안정해서 A2에서 더 다져야 해요.

notes: Produces 'a meeting', 'a report' correctly in memorized chunks, but drops the article with two-word nouns like 'action plan', 'project architecture meeting'.
Often breaks one sentence into fragments across turns, which makes articles and time words fall out; encourage finishing the whole short sentence in one breath.
'an' is pronounced as a bare vowel, so the following vowel-initial noun blends in; slowing the /n/ link ('an-apple') helps.
